Question: Before Ashley started a three-hour drive, her car’s odometer reading was \(29792,\) a palindrome. (A palindrome is a number that reads the same way from left to right as it does from right to left.) At her destination, the odometer reading was another palindrome. If Ashley never exceeded the speed limit of \(75\) miles per hour, which of the following was her greatest possible average speed?
